name: Dark Mist
doc: Dark Mist / Poison Mist (Anacondaur's enemy attacks): one emitter per action - a swirl at the caster's mouth, a mist controller throwing a cloud, mist puffs and streams toward the target, puffs round it, the target redrawn wobbling; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag013_dark_mist.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the swirl at the caster's mouth at once, the mist controller, the damage, its sound

parts.title: Mist
parts.doc: The mist controller: the cloud, the mist puffs thrown to the target, the streams, the puffs round the target, the target's wobbling overlay
